name: risegen-provider-setup
displayName: risegen-provider-setup — configure RiseGen AI as a provider
description: Procedure for any code assistant to configure RiseGen AI as an inference provider in IDEs, SDKs, and other products.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Base URL https://nex-global.risegen.ai/v1, key from risegen-access-keys Family A. Always re-fetch GET /v1/models before listing ids.
usage.engineers: Gateway ranks lanes hosted/plan/payg. One key sees all models. Trae uses custom_openai_compatible with Full URL off.
usage.founders: No new keys minted. The founder's existing gateway key is reused. Secrets stay out of git and out of chat.
